fields.summary_ko.0: TSM reported Q3 2026 revenue growth of 41.2% YoY and EPS growth of 57.5% YoY, driven by strong AI demand but facing increased operational burdens.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSM upgraded its 2026 revenue growth outlook from over 40% to approximately 44%, with accelerating adoption of advanced-node processes (N2), though net profit margin is expected to decline 2–4% due to overseas factory expansion.
